problem_statement: The digital microphone (PDM/DMIC) API cannot be configured from devicetree. There is no way to build a pdm_io_cfg from a devicetree node describing the microphone's allowable PDM clock frequency and duty-cycle ranges, and no way to query from devicetree which PDM channels (left/right) a microphone provides. A devicetree node using compatible "zephyr,pdm-dmic" with properties clk-frequency-min, clk-frequency-max, clk-duty-cycle-min, clk-duty-cycle-max, channel-left and channel-right should be usable to construct a pdm_io_cfg and to test the presence of left/right channels.

verification.reason: The statement describes the desired devicetree behaviour but omits the public macro names the tests use; this can be repaired by adding the exact macro interface without revealing the implementation.

problems.detail: The hidden tests require the exact macro names PDM_DT_IO_CFG_GET, PDM_DT_HAS_LEFT_CHANNEL and PDM_DT_HAS_RIGHT_CHANNEL, but the problem statement does not give them.

problem_statement_fixed:
The digital microphone (PDM/DMIC) API cannot be configured from devicetree. There is no way to build a pdm_io_cfg from a devicetree node describing the microphone's allowable PDM clock frequency and duty-cycle ranges, and no way to query from devicetree which PDM channels (left/right) a microphone provides. A devicetree node using compatible "zephyr,pdm-dmic" with properties clk-frequency-min, clk-frequency-max, clk-duty-cycle-min, clk-duty-cycle-max, channel-left and channel-right should be usable to construct a pdm_io_cfg and to test the presence of left/right channels.

Three macros must be provided in the PDM/DMIC header (zephyr/audio/dmic.h):

- PDM_DT_IO_CFG_GET(node_id): returns a struct pdm_io_cfg whose fields min_pdm_clk_freq, max_pdm_clk_freq, min_pdm_clk_dc, and max_pdm_clk_dc are populated from the corresponding devicetree properties of the given node.
- PDM_DT_HAS_LEFT_CHANNEL(node_id): evaluates to true if the given devicetree node has the channel-left property present.
- PDM_DT_HAS_RIGHT_CHANNEL(node_id): evaluates to true if the given devicetree node has the channel-right property present.
